Definition: to glow, i.e. literally (to melt, burn, dry up) or figuratively (to show or incite passion)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to burn, be hot, be scorched, be charred; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be hot, be scorched; 1a2) to burn, be burned; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be scorched, be burned; 1b2) to burn; 1b3) to be dry, be angry; 1c) (Pilpel) to cause to burn
